# Aarau Typeface

> Aarau is a neo-grotesk variable sans serif typeface designed by Benjamin Miles. Aarau 0.2 and later are free for personal, non-commercial use and require a paid licence for commercial use.

Canonical website: https://benji-bitter.github.io/Aarau/
Source repository: https://github.com/Benji-Bitter/Aarau
Designer: Benjamin Miles
Version: 0.2 development release
Licence: Aarau Font Licence Agreement v1.0
Licence page: https://benji-bitter.github.io/Aarau/license.html

## Key facts
- Aarau is a neo-grotesk sans serif typeface.
- It includes nine static weights: Thin 100, ExtraLight 200, Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600, Bold 700, ExtraBold 800 and Black 900.
- It includes a continuous variable font covering weight 100 through 900.
- Distributed formats include TTF, OTF and WOFF2/webfonts.
- Personal, non-commercial use is free.
- Commercial use requires a paid licence.
- Standard commercial pricing starts at A$39.
- Individual commercial: A$39.
- Small team up to 5 users: A$99.
- Web licence for one domain: A$79.
- App/software embedding: from A$399.
- Enterprise and extended use: custom quote.
- Commercial enquiries: benmilespersonal@gmail.com
- It is intended for identities, user interfaces, editorial design and everyday communication.

## Legacy licence note
Copies of Aarau 0.1 previously distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 remain under those earlier terms. Aarau 0.2 and later use the Aarau Font Licence Agreement.

## Primary pages
- Homepage and specimen: https://benji-bitter.github.io/Aarau/
- Licence and pricing: https://benji-bitter.github.io/Aarau/license.html
- Personal-use font download: https://benji-bitter.github.io/Aarau/downloads/Aarau-fonts.zip

## Entity disambiguation
“Aarau” on this website refers to the Aarau typeface by Benjamin Miles, not the city of Aarau in Switzerland.
